primary_spec.title: OpenGL4.6 Core, May5 2022, sections8.14 and8.15
primary_spec.rules: Isotropic filtering applies at anisotropy1. Magnification is selected for clamped lambda<=0 and uses the base image. The permitted derivative-based scale approximation is bounded by sqrt(2) times the largest sum of absolute coordinate derivatives; NEAREST selects one texel. Native textureGrad supplies its explicit derivatives.

own_derivation: Shader guard max(dot(gx,gx),dot(gy,gy))<1/64 bounds each 2D derivative Euclidean norm below1/8. Its L1 norm is below sqrt(2)/8, so even the permitted sqrt(2)*L1 scale upper bound stays below1/4. The factor4 gap to rho1 avoids a borderline MIN/MAG argument; small float error at the guarded1/8 threshold cannot bridge it.
LOD bias0 leaves negative lambda; native minLOD0 clamps it to0, which still selects MAG, and baseLevel0 is required. MaxLOD4 does not alter this conclusion.

For each omitted coordinate, support recomputes the same fract(local)*nativeScale+nativeOffset UV as ReadNormal. Its floor address and all immediate neighbors must lie inside the measured static sprite rectangle. The one-texel margin protects boundary/address rounding; wrapped coordinates are checked afresh each step.

Every measured alpha byte in that rectangle is<=M. Identity alpha swizzle and 8bit UNORM storage bound the native nearest height. H is rounded upward from(M+1)/255 (or1 forM>=254), adding a full code aboveM rather than trusting equality at a float rounding boundary.

At128, sampleStep1/128 and marched currentStep are exact binary values. coord is still incremented at every native iteration. An omitted fetch substitutesH only when the next currentStep>H; both original and substituted samples must keep the following break false. Native reads resume before that guarantee expires or support is lost. No bulk-coordinate advance changes rounding.

Synthetic real-atlas ray stress checks compare actual pinned ray function tokens, coordinates/depth/exit and positive omission. They do not count rendered pixels or establish displayed-image equivalence.
Private publication also requires unchanged source/profile/image/sampler/owner/epoch and restoration. Public unsized admission remains unavailable.
